title: ALPHA PHYSIQUE // MOTIVATION
premise: A physique is assembled as a live sculpt. The hub supplies the next component instead of presenting a finished character.

sequence.name: FOUNDATION
sequence.description: A neutral adult body shell establishes scale and continuity.

sequence.name: SHOULDER MASS
sequence.description: Broader shoulder geometry is added and joined to the existing torso.

sequence.name: CHEST PLATE
sequence.description: The chest volume is sculpted into the current silhouette.

sequence.name: ARMS
sequence.description: Left and right arm components arrive as separate sculptable pieces.

sequence.name: LARGER JOINTS
sequence.description: Elbows and wrists are thickened so the scale remains structurally continuous.

sequence.name: PELVIS / LOWER ANATOMY
sequence.description: Lower-body anatomy is sculpted as a separate adult body component, preserving balance, attachment, and continuity.

sequence.name: LEGS
sequence.description: Longer, heavier legs extend the model without changing its identity.

sequence.name: TANK TOP
sequence.description: A fitted tank becomes a separate clothing asset that can be moved or replaced.

sequence.name: POSING SHORTS
sequence.description: A separate clothing component completes the current sculpt pass.

event_rule: description -> component -> sculpt -> fit -> next component
completion: The event ends on a larger continuous baseline, with every piece remaining individually addressable.
